text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome secondary to obstructive lung disease (likely asthma exacerbated by occupational dust exposure). The elevated urinary cortisol confirms endocrine pathology, while the obstructive lung function tests and bronchial thickening on imaging indicate respiratory compromise likely driven by the combination of underlying asthma and environmental triggers.
